objective: maximize durable medical mastery per learner minute while building enough trustworthy internal-test inventory to exercise the exam simulator

batchSizing.rule: Choose the smallest batch at or above 25 that meaningfully closes exam-value coverage gaps without unnecessary duplication.

conceptSelectionOrder.rule: Use verified Exam DNA/PYQ evidence when available. Never infer or invent exam frequency, recurrence, or PYQ provenance.
Prefer high-value canonical concepts not yet represented by enough distinct testable items.
Prefer concepts useful to both NEET-PG and INI-CET when evidence and medical scope support that reuse.
Prefer concepts that unlock reasoning, prerequisites, emergency decisions, or multiple related concepts.
Cluster several original questions around authoritative current sources so reference and rights review evidence is reusable.
Deprioritize semantically redundant questions even when more inventory would be easy to generate.

examValueUncertainty.rule: When verified exam evidence is insufficient, mark prioritization as heuristic and do not present inferred weights as observed exam frequency.
